# OrphanGripPointRule

**Class** · namespace `VRFramework.Core.Editors.Validation` · assembly `VRFramework.Core.Editors` · [view source](https://git.cie-group.cz/vr-framework/vrf4/core/-/blob/interaction/physics-hold/Editor/Validation/Rules/GripRules.cs#L501)

Checks grip points that are not part of any grabbable.

A grip point does nothing on its own. It is collected by the [`GrabbableObject`](/api/vrframework-interaction-runtime/GrabbableObject)
above it, so one that is not under a grabbable is inert - it draws its gizmo, it looks
configured, and no hand will ever land on it. Reparenting an object, or adding the point
before the grabbable, is all it takes.

Its own rule rather than a check on the grabbable, because the whole point is that there is no
grabbable to hang it off: a per-grabbable pass cannot see a point no grabbable owns.

```csharp
public class OrphanGripPointRule : ValidationRule
```
